newsitem.title: CANADA: Campbell Resources to deepen Quebec shaft.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Resources to deepen Quebec shaft.

text.p: Campbell Resources said on Tuesday it has decided to spend C$14.5 million to deepen the production shaft at its Joe Mann mine in northern Quebec.
The 1,100-foot shaft extension will deepen the shaft to a depth of 3,780 feet from 2,680 feet, the company said.
Campbell said it will finance the project internally from cash on hand of C$57.2 million.
The deepened shaft will allow access to mine the 1.5 milion tons of ore grading 0.267 ounces of gold per ton or 404,000 ounces of gold identified in the deposit, the company said.
The mine is on schedule to produce 69,000 ounces of gold in 1996, Campbell said.
Construction on the shaft is to begin in December and will take up to 18 months to complete.
